subject: Playbook itemization + deck handback for HarborHealth exec session
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@harborhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Playbook itemization + deck handback for HarborHealth exec session

Team / Alex —

Attached is a first-pass playbook for the 2-day exec session (attached as "2027-08-10_playbook-draft.pdf"). I focused this round on the following ask areas where I need quick confirmation:  

1) Presenter buckets — a concise split between executive narrative, product demo, and breakout facilitation. See the attached "presenter-buckets-v2.xlsx" (tab: proposed-buckets).
2) Deck handback cadence — we propose two handbacks: initial slide deck by EOD Aug 20 and final locked deck by Aug 26. Any conflicts with HarborHealth approvals?
3) Pre-read triage — Alex asked for a single one-page executive pre-read + appendix. I drafted a onepager (hh_pre-read-onepager.docx) — hope it keeps leadership prep light.

Can Ben and Marissa review presenter ownership and call out gaps by EOD tomorrow? Kimberly, can you confirm AV/room needs against the split-day format (main plenary + two concurrent breakouts)?

Alex — if you can confirm whether procurement needs the locked deck before Aug 26 for vendor signoff, that would help the timeline.

Thanks —
Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Program Manager, Customer Experience
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@harborhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Playbook itemization + deck handback for HarborHealth exec session

On Tue, Aug 10, 2027 at 4:12 PM Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team / Alex —
> 
> Attached is a first-pass playbook for the 2-day exec session ...

Thanks Hannah — quick notes from content side as I reviewed presenter-buckets-v2:  

- Executive narrative: Marcus Lin will take the opening narrative (why we partnered, impact examples) and needs 4 slides (~6 mins) — I can own alignment with Marcus.
- Product demo: I suggest condensing the demo to 12 minutes (live + 1 backup recording) to keep time for the panel Q. Assigning Ben Carter (me) + Marissa for run-throughs.
- Breakouts: propose two themes — "Cost & Ops" and "Platform Roadmap". Kimberly, can you staff a facilitator for the ops session?

Action items I can pick up:  
- Update presenter spreadsheet with timings + slide owners (I'll push v3 by COB tonight).
- Draft a short run-of-show with explicit handback timestamps for slide drafts.

One operational note: the deck handback cadence looks fine, but if HarborHealth procurement needs any signed SOW excerpts with the deck, loop me in so we can mark redacted slides ahead of time.

Ben

--
Ben Carter
Director, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@harborhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Playbook itemization + deck handback for HarborHealth exec session

Thanks for the thorough start — this looks promising. A few points from HarborHealth:  

- Procurement: we do NOT need the final locked deck before Aug 26 for legal review, but Finance will want the high-level pricing slide by Aug 22 (pricing can be redacted if necessary). I copied procurement@harborhealth.com for visibility.
- Pre-read: yes to the single one-page exec summary. Please limit the appendix to 2 supporting artifacts (1 pager each). Anything longer and leadership won't read it.
- Speakers: prefer a single moderator for the panel rather than multiple moderators. If Redwood can nominate a moderator, please do so by Aug 18.

Availability: I'll be on site Aug 29-30 and available for a 30-minute run-through the morning of Aug 28.

Alex Turner
VP, Digital Transformation
HarborHealth

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

> Thanks for the thorough start — this looks promising. A few points from HarborHealth: 

Great — thanks Alex. Recap / next steps I captured:  

1) Ben to deliver presenter-buckets-v3 + draft run-of-show by COB Aug 11 (Ben: please confirm if v3 is uploaded to the Drive link).
2) Hannah to finalize playbook draft based on Ben's timings and Alex's pre-read guidance (one page + two appendix docs) — target: Aug 15 (draft) / Aug 20 (internal review).
3) Redwood to nominate single panel moderator by Aug 18 (Ben happy to accept if you'd like me to).
4) Kimberly to confirm AV and breakout room staffing by Aug 16.
5) HarborHealth needs high-level pricing slide by Aug 22 — send to procurement@harborhealth.com.

Attachments: I uploaded the 3 files referenced in the thread to the shared Drive folder. I'll lock the Drive permissions to HarborHealth:viewer + Redwood:edit after Hannah signals playbook ready for review.

I'll send a short calendar with the Aug 28 run-through and the Aug 29-30 onsite timeline once dates are finalized.

Marissa
